name: EpiModel
description: R package for mathematical and statistical modeling of infectious disease dynamics on contact networks. Developed by the Statnet development team at the University of Washington. Supports deterministic compartmental (SIR/SIS/SEIR) and stochastic individual contact models on dynamic networks using the Exponential Random Graph Model (ERGM) framework. Widely used for HIV transmission modeling, STI dynamics, and evaluation of prevention interventions in network-structured populations.
general_score_metric: epidemiological_outcomes (incidence, prevalence, effective reproduction number, attack rate)
reputation: Widely used R package in network epidemiology; published in Journal of Statistical Software; adopted by CDC and NIH researchers
notes: Published in Journal of Statistical Software (2018). Available on CRAN. Integrates with the statnet suite of R packages for network analysis. Primary applications include HIV/STI transmission modeling and PrEP intervention studies.
